components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled dashboard action with a clear pressed and focus-visible state.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 68%, transparent); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 14px; color: #10121a; background: var(--color-accent-soft); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent-soft) 88%, white); } .ds-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action on a raised dashboard surface.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 10px; padding: 0 11px; color: #a9afc1; background: rgba(23, 27, 35, 0.98); font: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 550; transition: background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 42%, transparent); color: #edf1f8; } .ds-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: API Key Input
components.description: Compact credential field with a visible accent focus treatment.
components.html: <input class="ds-key-input" type="password" placeholder="AIza…" aria-label="Gemini API key">
components.css: .ds-key-input { width: 100%; min-width: 180px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid #1f2230; border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 12px; color: #e4e4e7; background: #08090d; font-family: Cascadia Code, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-key-input::placeholder { color: #a1a6b5; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-key-input:focus-visible { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 60%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected dashboard section with a restrained accent-tinted surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 10px; color: #a9afc1; font-family: inherit; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav:hover, .ds-nav:focus-visible { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); color: #edf1f8; background: color-mix(in oklab, #edf1f8 5%, transparent); } .ds-nav.is-active { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 26%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)); color: #edf1f8; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 10%, rgba(17, 20, 27, 0.96)); } .ds-nav.is-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dashboard Surface
components.description: Flat dashboard container whose tonal surface and border provide separation.
components.html:
Gemini API key

Stored securely on this device.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px; color: #edf1f8; background: rgba(17, 20, 27, 0.96); } .ds-card strong { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 620; } .ds-card p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: #a9afc1; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) { .ds-card { border-color: rgba(22, 27, 40, 0.12); color: #202431; background: #ffffff; } .ds-card p { color: #5b6274; } }

components.name: Selected Loadout Chip
components.description: Pressed choice chip with an accent border and tinted fill.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 30px; border: 1px solid #1f2230; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; color: #d4d4d8; background: rgba(19, 21, 29, 0.5); font: inherit; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 30%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent-soft); } .ds-chip.is-selected { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 60%, transparent); color: var(--color-accent-soft); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 15%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Notch Answer
components.description: Expanded answer state that grows from the compact floating notch.
components.css: .ds-notch-answer { display: flex; width: min(468px, calc(100vw - 24px)); min-height: 60px; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 20px; padding: 14px 16px; color: #f2f3f9; background: rgba(11, 12, 17, 0.94); box-shadow: 0 24px 70px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(150%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(150%); } .ds-notch-answer p { flex: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-copy { border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; color: #9aa0b4; background: color-mix(in oklab, #f2f3f9 6%, transparent); font: inherit; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-copy:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-copy:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7b2ff; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: light) { .ds-notch-answer { border-color: rgba(16, 19, 32, 0.11); color: #14161f; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94); box-shadow: 0 20px 55px -24px rgba(15, 18, 30, 0.34); } .ds-copy { border-color: rgba(16, 19, 32, 0.11); color: #5b6072; } }

components.name: Control Centre Toggle
components.description: Compact system setting tile with a clear on-state and practical target.
components.css: .ds-cc-toggle { display: flex; min-height: 58px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 11px; padding: 8px 10px; color: #f3f5ff; text-align: left; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-cc-toggle:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11); } .ds-cc-toggle:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-cc-toggle.is-on { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #a7b2ff 44%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, #a7b2ff 18%, rgba(11, 14, 20, 0.7)); } .ds-cc-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a7b2ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cc-mark { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none; place-items: center; border-radius: 9px; color: #a7b2ff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-cc-toggle > span:last-child { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-cc-toggle strong { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-cc-toggle small { color: rgba(231, 235, 248, 0.58); font-size: 9px; }

narrative.overview:
Murmur is a restrained desktop workspace for voice-driven actions, not a promotional surface. The interface feels precise, dependable, and low-distraction: graphite-like tonal layers, compact labels, and a muted periwinkle cue make state changes legible without competing with the task at hand.

The main dashboard uses both dark and light palettes and keeps its surfaces mostly flat. A separate transient language belongs to the notch and Control Centre: translucent, blurred, and elevated because these panels float over other work. That distinction preserves the in-app workspace as quiet while giving overlays enough separation to be read at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite neutrals with a configurable periwinkle-first accent.
Compact, clear hierarchy in Segoe UI Variable Text.
Tonal surfaces and fine borders do most of the dashboard layering.
Glass, blur, and stronger shadows are scoped to floating surfaces.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Keep dark and light mappings together: changing a neutral role in one mode must preserve the same hierarchy in the other.

rules.name: The Task-First Type Rule
rules.body: Reserve the largest size for the current section's primary heading; keep secondary information quieter and avoid widening the hierarchy with display styles.

rules.name: The Flat-First Rule
rules.body: Do not add resting elevation to ordinary dashboard cards; tonal layers and borders already define their edges.

rules.name: The Overlay Glass Rule
rules.body: Keep blur and stronger elevation on the notch and Control Centre, where translucency separates floating windows from the desktop.

dos: Do use the actual theme tokens for the selected accent and paired dark/light neutrals.
Do keep dashboard hierarchy primarily tonal, with visible focus and selected states.
Do preserve the notch and Control Centre as distinct, floating overlay surfaces.
Do let responsive dashboard navigation become horizontally scrollable instead of squeezing its labels.
donts: Don't add decorative effects that compete with the user's active task.
Don't spread backdrop blur or heavy shadows from the overlays into ordinary dashboard cards.
Don't treat the existing Overview eyebrow or its large preview composition as a reusable system rule; those remain surface-specific implementation details.
